cpuFix.behavior: Optional saved-radio lookup and compilation verification stay suspended throughout resolving, buffering and playing, independently of volume. A 30-second quiet period follows inactive playback. Interrupted saved-radio work retries afterward. Next-track preparation remains available.
cpuFix.track: Nipsey Hussle — Mac 11 On the Dresser
measurementLimits: Single paired 90-second Linux trials, fresh profiles and four public saved-radio preparation jobs. 100 percent CPU means one logical core.
Both matched trial windows were hidden. The first trial pair had different rendering costs and is excluded from the comparative CPU conclusion.
Initial foreground source extraction still uses helpers and can cause a short CPU burst; this change removes unrelated background lookup during playback.
Visible UI retains a separate rendering cost; this is not a fan-RPM or Mac-hardware measurement.

albumFix.behavior: Album links on library tracks and My library search results open the complete catalog release. Album rows show an accessible green check for saved recordings.
albumFix.membership: Bounded, local-only batched reads. Exact saved/merged identity or conservative album, artist, title/version, duration and ISRC evidence. Cached search results alone do not count as saved.
coverage: Both library entry points with no Spotify session and a complete public album containing unsaved tracks.
Saved badges, failed reads, save-event refresh, bounded batches and cancellation on navigation.
Native cross-provider membership without authentication, incompatible artist/version/duration/ISRC, cache-only negatives and merged identities.
